This proves movement without rewriting the script, not that transforms were executed successfully for every locale.",
        "The address-book checkSearchResults helper becomes async. It checks row count and names, waits for L10nMutationsFinished only when mutations are pending, then checks the status value for zero, singular and plural result cases.
